nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We first check if the actor is valid to avoid any output errors if this check is being run on brush geometry (which doesn\'t return an actor object and doesn\'t support actor tags). If it\'s not valid and a tag is required for wall running, we return false since brush geometry will never be tagged.
